page.overview:
Who is Juliet?

Juliet is a female Triceratops that lives near the Raptor Encounter attraction at Universal Studios Hollywood. She can occasionally be seen walking around the Jurassic World area accompanied by a dinosaur handler. She was first debuted on July 4, 2019.
